rule: Never invent a citation. Every retrieved record must carry source, request URL and retrieval timestamp. Respect rate limits and each provider's terms of use.
polite_identification: Set a real contact e-mail in OPENALEX_MAILTO / CROSSREF_MAILTO when running large batches.

openalex.auth: optional key or mailto query parameter
openalex.strength: broad multidisciplinary coverage, citation graph, concepts
openalex.weakness: metadata inherited from repositories; verify journal/DOI against Crossref

crossref.strength: DOI registry of record, publisher-deposited metadata
crossref.weakness: no abstracts for many records; does not guarantee content

arxiv.strength: preprints with full text, version history
arxiv.weakness: not peer reviewed; overlapping published versions

semanticscholar.rate_limit: unauthenticated pool is shared and aggressively throttled
semanticscholar.strength: citation graph, TLDRs, open-access PDF links

pubmed.weakness: no full text; limited to life sciences

unpaywall.weakness: does not resolve paywalled content; never bypass access controls

forbidden_practices: Using Sci-Hub or other copyright-infringing full-text fallbacks
Presenting a preprint as a peer-reviewed article
Citing a paper whose abstract/full text was never read
Silently substituting metadata from a different edition/version

openalex_work_by_doi.caveat: Boolean derived from Retraction Watch; has produced false positives and can lag.

crossref_work_by_doi.caveat: Notices come from Retraction Watch since 2023 acquisition; type values are heterogeneous.

integrity_policy: Never treat a single registry flag as a retraction verdict. Require >=2 converging signals for a blocking result; label a single signal "suspected"; report lookup failures; always tell the human to confirm on the publisher page.
